_comment: Pins for `terrabuilder toolchain --from-source`. External inputs are hash- or commit-pinned; retained checked-in artifacts are byte-pinned under retained_artifacts. scripts/toolchain/build_from_source.py reads this file instead of hardcoding versions. Update it (and docs/BUILDING.md provenance notes) when a pin changes.

toolchain._comment: Builds release CoreLib/framework, the release native Mono runtime, and the LLVM AOT cross compiler.

mesa._comment: Separate, older devkitA64 pin: newer toolchains build a Mesa that runs ~2x slower on the GPU (see scripts/mesa/Containerfile).

runtime._comment: dotnet/runtime libnx port. The public branch tip already includes the switch-table-data-memory and sockets-console-DEBUG-guard fixes; only the two patches below are still unapplied on it.

mono_nx_sdk._comment: Prebuilt Debug-config mono-nx SDK baseline (ICU static libs + Debug mono-aot-cross + Debug runtime), produced by mono-nx's own gather_sdk.sh and published by the upstream author. Mounted read-only at /mono-nx for every build step. The toolchain's `sdk` component is this zip extracted as-is.

mojoshader._comment: Pinned transitively: FNA3D's own submodule reference at the commit above.

cecil._comment: Mono.Cecil, Mono.Cecil.Rocks, Mono.Cecil.Mdb, Mono.Cecil.Pdb all ship in the single mono.cecil NuGet package (lib/netstandard2.0/*.dll).

retained_artifacts._comment: Checked-in, hash-pinned artifacts that are copied unchanged during a from-source toolchain build rather than regenerated. Each SHA-256 covers the complete assembly metadata, including type forwarders.

facades.origin: Validated build 52 runtime-romfs facades; byte-for-byte identical to the validated toolchain's facades component.
